audit.why: TRICKY 7/10 fits 50.79% over 2865 games: he bullies early windows, Ryze snaps it back at two items.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full chart disagreed with content/packet on rows 1-6 (full: Yone,Yone,Skill,Yone,Skill,Skill; content/packet: Skill,Ryze,Yone,Skill,Yone,Ryze). Content whys[4] also argued 'Level 6 is Yone's' under its own Skill row.
audit.why: Content and packet agree on the chart. Level 3 Flux-root burst lands while his Q3/E are down; 4-5 his E rewind undoes root commits; 6 is even because Fate Sealed is a telegraphed 1000-range line; first item his bruiser all-in outpaces an unstacked Q; two items flip it to Ryze.
audit.corrected: Full sides aligned with why and rating rewrites; whys[4] rewritten to match its Skill verdict; win[] already correct.

audit.whatIsWrong: packet defect: the page never named any Yone ability in the flagged fields. Full-layer bullets were generic — no Spirit Cleave shield mechanics, no Q3/R straight-line dash pattern for the root, no E cooldown numbers.
audit.why: Kit: Soul Unbound (E) 22/19/16/13/10s; Spirit Cleave (W) 14s, shield scales with champions hit; Q3 and R are line dashes Ryze W stops when Flux-rooted.
audit.corrected: Real names and numbers folded into breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[1].d, dontsFull[1-2].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: dontsFull[1].d referenced 'a Zed mark' in a Yone matchup.

edits.before: W online: the point-blank root answers anyone who closes. Trade Q-W-Q only when his engage tool is down.
edits.after: W online: the slow answers his Q dash-in, but your combo is not up — even trades decided by spacing.

edits.before: E unlocks the real combo: E-Q flux chunks and the wave-bounce clears. The lane starts being yours to play.
edits.after: E unlocks the real combo: Flux-root and Q-E-Q chunk him while his Q3 knockup and E are down. Punish here.

edits.before: Tear + Lost Chapter and the EQ machine hums — short-trade his every wave contact and walk away before the answer.
edits.after: His E rewind undoes your root commits — Soul Unbound trades take half the damage home. Short-trade and back off.

edits.before: Realm Warp online — you are now a map play waiting to happen. The lane is a timer: shove and warp somewhere profitable.
edits.after: His R is a 1000-range line knockup — telegraphed, so 6 stays even if you dodge. Shove and warp somewhere profitable.

edits.before: RoA spike: your combo chunks half bars and your root starts kill chains. Force the trades you spent five levels avoiding.
edits.after: RoA steadies you but his bruiser one-item all-in still outpaces the not-yet-stacked Q. Keep short trades, keep farming.

edits.before: Two items and you ARE the win condition: EQ deletes carries, W stops divers, and Realm Warp turns objectives into ambushes.
edits.after: Two items and you melt him before the E-rewind saves it: EQ deletes, W stops the dive, Realm Warp wins objectives.

edits.before: - Yone Soul Unbound: matchup-defining — His burst window — survive it and punish the body he snaps back to. Check it before every step-up. - W Rune Prison is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Soul Unbound (E): 22s at rank 1, 10s max — his burst window; survive it and punish the body he snaps back to. - Spirit Cleave shield: 14s base — poke it out before real trades. - W Rune Prison is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it.

edits.before: E the wave, Q the flux bounce, and W-root if he steps to answer — three-spell trades that end before his combo starts.
edits.after: His Q3 gust and his R both dash in straight lines — land Flux first so the W root stops him the instant he commits.

edits.before: Your root is your only 'stop' button — a W spent poking is a Zed mark you can't answer.
edits.after: Your root is your only 'stop' button — hold it for his E-return or the Q3 dash, never for poke.

edits.before: Spending W on poke and then face-tanking the engage it was born to stop — rootless Ryze is a Tear with a health bar.
edits.after: His Spirit Cleave shield grows per champion hit and his Q3 charges off the wave — inside it he trades with armor on.

edits.before: Flash + Teleport, always — Ryze is a scaling map champion and TP doubles the thesis. Nothing else is defensible on him.
edits.after: Flash + Teleport, always — Ryze is a scaling map champion and TP extends the map game. Nothing else is defensible on him.

edits.before: Level 6 is Yone's: his R knockup all-in beats your slow, non-combat Realm Warp.
edits.after: Level 6 skill: his R knockup is huge but a dodgeable 1000-range line — spacing decides.
